does_not_apply_to: 20-iteration Smoke; Smoke is mechanics-only and performs no model selection

change.checkpoint_selection_eligibility: Only validation checkpoints after iteration 50 are eligible in the 300-iteration screening.

reason: A validation checkpoint produced while force_gate_one=true must not be selected as a deployed learned-gate checkpoint because reloading model weights does not serialize the transient force_gate_one runtime flag.
